cases.prompt: A pro editor has hundreds of commands but only pointer-accessible toolbar buttons.
cases.failure: A professional editor exposes hundreds of commands only through pointer-accessible toolbar buttons, leaving keyboard users without complete or discoverable command access.

cases.prompt: A phone app puts destructive icon buttons 16px apart and relies on hover tooltips.
cases.failure: A phone interface places destructive icon controls only sixteen pixels apart and relies on hover tooltips that touch users cannot access.

cases.prompt: Cards can only be reordered by dragging.
cases.failure: Cards can only be reordered through drag gestures, leaving keyboard, switch, and single-pointer users without an equivalent operation path.

cases.prompt: A streaming TV grid opens a modal whose close button cannot be reached by D-pad.
cases.failure: A television modal opens from a streaming grid but its close control is unreachable by directional focus, trapping remote-only users.

cases.prompt: A voice assistant executes 'send it' when two drafts are visible.
cases.failure: A voice assistant executes the ambiguous command send it while two drafts are visible, without resolving the referent or consequence.

cases.prompt: Every gaze target activates after a short dwell with no hand confirmation.
cases.failure: Every gaze target activates after a short dwell without a separate intent signal, causing Midas-touch errors and sustained dwell fatigue.

cases.prompt: Critical failure is communicated only by a vibration pattern.
cases.failure: A critical system failure is communicated only through vibration, so users can miss it when haptics are unavailable, masked, or imperceptible.

cases.prompt: A complex tool has custom canvas controls omitted from sequential navigation.
cases.failure: Custom canvas controls are omitted from sequential navigation, preventing switch and alternative-input users from reaching or operating the complete tool.
